## About Us

Our mission at Anthropologie has always been to surprise and delight you with unexpected,
distinctive finds for your closet and home. We source and craft all of our products with care,
ensuring that any treasure you find at Anthropologie is unique, just like you. Explore
our [dresses][48] shop to find styles and fits perfect for any occasion, from [cocktail party
dresses][49] to [wedding guest dresses][50] to [casual daytime][51] silhouettes. Shop Anthropologie
Weddings and take a look at our selection of [wedding dresses][52] and [bridesmaids dresses][53].
Browse [party skirts][54], [wide-leg pants][55] and [jeans][56], and [blouses][57] that will turn
heads. Complete your look with uncommon accessories—think only-here [slides][58] and head-turning
[totes][59]. Discover our expansive home collections, from [furniture][60]
to [curtains][61], [decorative pillows][62] to [duvets][63], [wall art][64] to [Moroccan-inspired
rugs][65]. Looking for a [housewarming gift][66]? Try a [coffee table book][67],
original [glassware][68] or a set of [coasters][69].

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# We are Inizio.

Empowering health and life sciences companies to transform patients’ lives. 

[Discover what we do][197]

# Four steps to a smarter congress strategy

Transform congresses into connected strategic experiences.

[Download the guidebook][198]

# Blind spots putting your launch at risk?

Discover how InConcert™ brings clarity to launch planning.

[Learn more][199]

# STEM AI.

An AI-powered call recording and analysis solution that transforms real-world HCP interactions into
personalized coaching, actionable insights, and strategic reporting. 

[Discover STEM AI][200]

## Your global Intelligent Commercialization™ partner.

With unmatched scale and scientific expertise, we’re by your side at every stage of the clinical
development and commercialization journey – connecting data, technology, and AI with expert insight
to simplify the complex, unlock value, and realize your product’s potential.

[Learn more][201]

## For every pivotal moment in your product’s lifecycle.

From your earliest breakthroughs to loss of exclusivity, we’ll put an experienced, connected team
right at your fingertips, helping you achieve insight-driven, tech-enabled results at scale.

[Tap to view Discovery]
[Background image for Discovery]

### Discovery

Exploring your opportunities with expert market research and strategy consulting.

[Tap to view Development]
[Background image for Development]

### Development

Advancing your asset through development with integrated scientific strategy, stakeholder
engagement, and communications expertise.

[Tap to view Pre-launch]
[Background image for Pre-launch]

### Pre-launch

Building your evidence base and getting powerful data to pivotal decision-makers.

[Tap to view Launch]
[Background image for Launch]

### Launch

Making maximum impact from day one, with a robust sales and engagement strategy.

[Tap to view Post-launch]
[Background image for Post-launch]

### Post-launch

Driving lasting impact through experiences, medical education, patient services, and analytics.

## Global scale. Proven results.

By maximizing asset value at every opportunity, we drive measurable and lasting results that deliver
value for our clients.

>
experts across 50 countries
PhDs & 800 nurses on your team
>
pharma & biotech clients worldwide
%
of top 20 pharma as clients (WW Rx sales 2025-2027)

## Best-in-class experts, by your side.

Commercialization is a complex journey, which is why we bring you a team of talented experts trusted
by every top 20 pharma company in the world. 

### Deep, broad expertise.

With unmatched scale and scientific understanding, we pair multidisciplinary human expertise with AI
innovation to get life-changing products to patients faster.

### Solutions to every challenge.

We start with the challenges you face, creating tailored solutions powered by proprietary tech that
deliver exactly the support you need, every step of the way.

### People you’ll love working with.

We build real, lasting partnerships through a single point of contact, a dedicated account team,
rigorous governance, and seamless project delivery.

### Innovation that underpins everything.

We combine proprietary technology, AI, and human insight to deliver Intelligent Commercialization™ –
accelerating lasting impact for you and your patients.

[Get in touch][202]

## Specialized expertise,
## seamlessly connected.

Each of our five industry-leading businesses brings a deep and broad set of capabilities. Work with
one, several, or all – in the way that best supports your goals.

### *About* LifeStyles

LifeStyles’ story dates back to 1905, when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond
Australia. Today, LifeStyles is a global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising of a broad
range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products.

[ Know More ][53]

### Our *Products*

We blend our passion and purpose to make a difference in your lives and define Sexual Wellness in
the most natural and sensitive way possible. Our range of products have been carefully designed
keeping in mind the Wellness quotient and to create the near perfect intimate experience for you and
your partner.

[Condoms Brands]

### Condoms

[sample100]

### Lubes

[sample101]

### Toys

At LifeStyles Healthcare, the quality and safety of our products are of the utmost importance to us.
All our products meet local requirements from authorities related to their commercialization
including all regulatory requirements applicable to medical devices. We select our ingredients
carefully, according to the latest science in terms of performance and safety in compliance with
specific requirements like GHS and REACH in Europe or Prop 65 in California. We also choose our
suppliers according to even stricter internal benchmarks and conduct regular reviews and audits.

### Our *Brands*

We manufacture and market 18 global, regional and local brands of condoms and intimate products. Our
work extends to the social health market, as well. We supply our products to major government and
social organizations so that consumers have access to the sexual wellness products they need,
wherever they are.

## Why Lodha Petro ?

At **LODHA**, support is always within easy reach when you need answers or assistance. We have
specialist sales and customer service teams who understand your challenges. Our people are service
orientated — reliable and responsive. We also encourage innovative and entrepreneurial thinking
across the whole business.

### Each customer is special

LODHA has always been to understand the needs of our customers through continuous and open
communication and provide products that meet each needs.

### Technical Support

LODHA has well established fully equipped laboratories in. They provide formulation, analytical,
testing and training support with a primary focus on Beauty and Personal Care applications.

### Marketing Support

Ingredient Plus always has a eye on the future — looking at the latest trends and opportunities.This
is often translated into prototype formulation kits or dynamic customer seminars and training
sessions.

### Quality Assurance

Our products and processes are evaluated by the area of quality, which is aimed at maintaining the
quality assurance of all raw materials supplied to its customers, applying methodologies based on
national and international standards.

# Lodha Petro - A Manufacturer, Supplier and Exporter of Petroleum Products


**Lodha Petro** is Indian owned leading petroleum products Manufacturer, Supplier and Export
Company. From humble beginnings in 1995 we have grown to become a valued supplier of** petroleum
products** to various industries in many countries. During this time, we have established a
reputation as a supplier of the highest quality** petroleum products from India**. These are
delivered consistently to our valued customers, providing assurance and peace of mind.

Importing and exporting** petroleum products** is a complicated process with plenty of regulations
you need to adhere to. We at Lodha Petro can manage and assist in all aspect of export including
documentation, packaging and shipping. Lodha Petro offer a range of** speciality oils** and**
lubricants** products including White Mineral Oil, Liquid Paraffin, White Petroleum Jelly, Paraffin
Wax, Process Oils, Transformer Oils, Industrial Oils, Automotive Oils and other** speciality oils**.
All our** speciality oils** and** lubricants** are specially manufactured in India using only high
quality raw crude oil sourced from globally recognized, reputable companies.

Being the leading** speciality oils exporter in India** Lodha petro have well-trained and
experienced staff which is able to support its customers at the highest service level.Whatever your
requirements are, we will seek to understand them fully, honestly describe our performance
capability, and deliver on specification.

**Industrial Lubricants**Hydraulic, gear, compressor, turbine, and circulating oils for demanding
equipment.
**Specialty Products**Transmission fluids, brake fluids, coolants, greases, and application-specific
blends.
**OEM Supply**Private label, formulation, label, packaging, documentation, and export support.

## ¿Tenés dudas sobre Personal?

### ¿Tenés dudas sobre tu factura?

Podés acceder a la factura de tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o iniciando sesión en la web.
Solo tenés que ingresar a la sección “Mis facturas”. Si aún no tenés usuario, podés registrarte. El
registro es por única vez: el usuario y la contraseña que crees te van a servir para ingresar tanto
en la app como en la web de Mi Personal.

Una vez creado tu usuario, vas a poder consultar y descargar tus facturas desde tu computadora o
celular cuando lo necesites.

### ¿Qué beneficios tengo por tener más de un servicio de Personal?

Si tenés una línea móvil, junto a internet hogar y/o Flow bajo la misma titularidad, vas a poder
acceder a beneficios exclusivos, como descuento en la factura de tus servicios, descuentos en Tienda
Personal, WiFi Backup, Pack Mundo de regalo, y te duplicamos los gigas de tu plan. Conocé todo sobre
los [beneficios de Personal y Flow][57].

### ¿Cómo puedo gestionar mis servicios?

Gestioná tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o podes iniciar sesión en la web. Consultá el estado
de tus facturas, pagá, recargá crédito, descubrí los beneficios exclusivos que tenés y mucho más. Si
preferís medios de contacto tradicionales vas encontrar sucursales y teléfonos en la [página de
Contacto.][58]

### ¿Qué es Personal Pay?

Es la billetera virtual de Personal que te permite conectarte de una manera simple y segura con tu
plata. Con Personal Pay podés recargar crédito, pagar las facturas de tus servicios, aprovechar
descuentos y sumar muchos beneficios.

Descargá la app y descubrí todo sobre  [Personal Pay][59].

### ¿Fibertel ahora es Personal?

¡Exacto! Nos renovamos para ser más simples y brindarte la mejor **conexión adentro y afuera de tu
casa**. Ahora Personal te brinda el servicio de internet hogar, con la mejor velocidad. Si antes
Fibertel era tu proveedor de internet, no te preocupes, la unificación no implica ninguna tarea para
vos.

### ¿Qué es 5G y cómo funciona?

Es la nueva generación de conectividad móvil, que te permite navegar a más velocidad, con menor
latencia y una experiencia más fluida. Para usarla, necesitás tener un dispositivo compatible y
encontrarte dentro de la zona de cobertura. Conocé más sobre [cómo funciona el 5G y cómo
aprovecharlo][60].

## ¿Tenés dudas sobre Personal?

### ¿Tenés dudas sobre tu factura?

Podés acceder a la factura de tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o iniciando sesión en la web.
Solo tenés que ingresar a la sección “Mis facturas”. Si aún no tenés usuario, podés registrarte. El
registro es por única vez: el usuario y la contraseña que crees te van a servir para ingresar tanto
en la app como en la web de Mi Personal.

Una vez creado tu usuario, vas a poder consultar y descargar tus facturas desde tu computadora o
celular cuando lo necesites.

### ¿Qué beneficios tengo por tener más de un servicio de Personal?

Si tenés una línea móvil, junto a internet hogar y/o Flow bajo la misma titularidad, vas a poder
acceder a beneficios exclusivos, como descuento en la factura de tus servicios, descuentos en Tienda
Personal, WiFi Backup, Pack Mundo de regalo, y te duplicamos los gigas de tu plan. Conocé todo sobre
los [beneficios de Personal y Flow][57].

### ¿Cómo puedo gestionar mis servicios?

Gestioná tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o podes iniciar sesión en la web. Consultá el estado
de tus facturas, pagá, recargá crédito, descubrí los beneficios exclusivos que tenés y mucho más. Si
preferís medios de contacto tradicionales vas encontrar sucursales y teléfonos en la [página de
Contacto.][58]

### ¿Qué es Personal Pay?

Es la billetera virtual de Personal que te permite conectarte de una manera simple y segura con tu
plata. Con Personal Pay podés recargar crédito, pagar las facturas de tus servicios, aprovechar
descuentos y sumar muchos beneficios.

Descargá la app y descubrí todo sobre  [Personal Pay][59].

### ¿Fibertel ahora es Personal?

¡Exacto! Nos renovamos para ser más simples y brindarte la mejor **conexión adentro y afuera de tu
casa**. Ahora Personal te brinda el servicio de internet hogar, con la mejor velocidad. Si antes
Fibertel era tu proveedor de internet, no te preocupes, la unificación no implica ninguna tarea para
vos.

### ¿Qué es 5G y cómo funciona?

Es la nueva generación de conectividad móvil, que te permite navegar a más velocidad, con menor
latencia y una experiencia más fluida. Para usarla, necesitás tener un dispositivo compatible y
encontrarte dentro de la zona de cobertura. Conocé más sobre [cómo funciona el 5G y cómo
aprovecharlo][60].

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. Cooperation [[News] News ][207] [ProBio CDMO Awards] Awards * [news-image] * [news] * [news-image] [ProBio | GenScript ProBio - Global Biologics CDMO] ## About ProBio # ProBio – Biologics CDMO ProBio, a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## Welcome To

## PR Personal Care Laboratories

At PR Personal Care Laboratories, we specialize in the development, formulation, and manufacturing
of high-quality personal care products tailored to your unique needs. Whether you're looking for
massage oils, personal lubricants, feminine sprays, or body care products like shampoos,
conditioners, creams, lotions, and deodorants – we are your trusted partner in bringing your vision
to life.

[ Know More ][16]

## Your Gateway to Product Perfection.

PR Personal Care Laboratories is a leading manufacturer of cosmetics, medical devices, and OTC
drugs. As a leading manufacturing partner, we offer comprehensive private label and contract
manufacturing services to bring your unique products to life. From concept to formulation,
production to packaging, we provide tailored solutions that ensure your brand stands out in the
competitive market.
With an FDA registered facility that is GMP certified, a dedicated team of industry experts, and a
commitment to quality and compliance, we deliver exceptional results that meet your brand’s
standards. Whether you’re a startup or an established brand looking to expand your product line,
we’re here to help you create high-quality, innovative products that resonate with your customers.

[ Explore More ][17]
[About us Banner Image]

#### Latest Ingredients

PR Laboratories uses the latest ingredients from all around the world to create formulas that are
unique and exotic.

#### Low MOQ

The capability to manufacture as little as 750 units makes it easier for you to start your own
brand.

#### Formulations

You can use one of our many stock formulas or a new formula can be made specifically for your needs.

## Transforming Ideas Into Market-Ready Personal Care Products

## Your Trusted Lab for Personal Care Innovation

Create personalized products with our wide range of stock formulas or design something entirely new.
We tailor each formulation to match your brand’s unique needs and market trends.

## Precision Formulations for High-Impact Personal Care Products

PR Personal Care Laboratories is a leading manufacturer of cosmetics, medical devices, and OTC
drugs. We can help you design your product from the ground up or manufacture what you already have.
We have the capability to produce as little as 750 units to a couple thousand! Our goal is to help
you expand your brand.

From concept to creation, we work with you to develop unique formulas that reflect your brand's
identity, ensuring premium quality and performance.

We accommodate orders starting from 750 units, offering flexibility and dedication to small or
growing businesses without compromising quality.

From cosmetic products to OTC drugs and medical devices, we offer comprehensive manufacturing
solutions that meet stringent industry standards.

Our team ensures your products comply with all industry regulations and safety standards, giving you
peace of mind at every step.

We offer a range of packaging options, tailored to your brand's vision and functionality, with a
focus on sustainability and aesthetics.

Our meticulous attention to detail in every aspect of production ensures that your products meet the
highest standards of quality and consistency.

## Tailored Cosmetic Manufacturing Solutions

At PR Personal Care Laboratories, we offer customized product development, small-batch
manufacturing, and quality assurance, meeting all regulatory standards.

## Flexibility

We offer tailored solutions to meet your unique formulation and manufacturing needs. Whether it’s a
custom product or an adjustment to one of our stock formulas, we adapt to your specific
requirements.

## Efficiency

We understand that time is critical, so we streamline the entire process from formulation to
packaging, ensuring your product is developed and delivered in the shortest possible time without
compromising on quality.

## Strength

Our cutting-edge production facilities and advanced technologies ensure that your products are
manufactured with the highest level of precision and care, safeguarding both quality and
consistency.

## High RIO

As your one-stop personal care partner, we reduce your costs by offering comprehensive services—from
formulation and manufacturing to packaging—helping you maximize profits while maintaining
exceptional product quality.

Guangzhou Shuyou Daily Necessities Co., Ltd. was established in 2004, with its production base

meters. The Kunlong River's mountain spring is directly introduced into the factory, using the
unique high-quality mountain spring water as the base material. The factory has a 100000 level
purification workshop, a complete and scientific quality management system, high-tech sterilization
technology, large vacuum emulsifiers, and reverse osmosis RO pure water equipment imported from the
United States. Simultaneously possessing production qualifications for disinfection and hygiene
products and medical devices.

personal health care product service provider in China with a large scale, good service, and
advanced technology. We strive to repay shareholders, benefit humanity, serve society, and enhance
value.

many powerful companies and network experts to cooperate, such as Renhe Pharmaceutical, Yitong
Pharmaceutical, Huitong Pharmaceutical, Jiujiujia Pharmaceutical, Shuangyi Latex, Yuemu Network
Technology, etc.

Enterprise" by the Guangzhou Administration for Industry and Commerce for twelve consecutive years;

Enterprises; In April 2016, it was awarded the honorable title of "China Small and Medium sized
Enterprise Integrity Demonstration Unit" by the Credit Management Center of the China Association of
Small and Medium sized Enterprises.

Putting people first and quality first; continuously improving and creating win-win situations

contributions to the lives of consumers with excellent products, quality, and professional services.

Guangzhou Shuyou Daily Necessities Co., Ltd. was established in 2004, with its production base

products and medical devices.

personal health care product service provider in China with a large scale, good service, and

value.

Technology, etc.

Enterprises; In April 2016, it was awarded the honorable title of "China Small and Medium sized

Small and Medium sized Enterprises.

Putting people first and quality first; continuously improving and creating win-win situations

### Leading the way in personal care manufacturing since 1989, with a commitment to innovating
### body-positive products for happier, happier individuals. With end-to-end manufacturing as our
### core competency, we turn your idea into ready-to-sell finished goods.

[ Get in touch ][17]

# Personal Care Manufacturing

# Personal Care Manufacturing

# The Meaning of T-R-I-G-G
* T = TRUSTED
  
  Over 30 years of experience, 240+ successful SKUs, and industry-leading compliance,
  FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant, and ISO-certified. Your product is in expert hands.
* R = READY
  
  With proven bestsellers and custom formulation capabilities, our white label and private label
  offerings are designed to get you to market faster, with zero compromise on quality.
* I = INSIGHTFUL
  
  We leverage our deep category knowledge to help brands anticipate trends, meet evolving customer
  needs, and navigate regulatory complexity, including FDA 510(k) innovation.
* G = GUIDED
  
  From your first consult to post-launch success, we offer hands-on support through product
  development, compliance, design, and go-to-market strategy.
* G = GROWTH-DRIVEN
  
  Whether you're launching DTC, FDM, selling on Amazon, or scaling into retail, our flexible MOQs
  and scalable systems are built for growth, yours.

[ Get Started ][18]
* ## Your brand. Our Expertise. Unmatched Together.
  
  Trigg Laboratories

# Our Services

#### Product Formulation

IN-HOUSE & VIA PARTNERSHIP

Trigg Laboratories is unique in that we offer both in-house formulation consultation as well as
working with third-party formulators to create and test samples until all parties have reached the
best quality product prior to manufacturing.

#### Volume Sourcing

IN-HOUSE

We source the highest-qualities ingredients and raw materials from around the world. All materials
are purchased in bulk quantities so you are able to benefit from economies achieved at volume scale.

#### At-Scale Manufacturing

IN-HOUSE

With 70,000+ sq ft, Trigg Laboratories has been engineered to scale manufacturing for all our
customers. Capacity constraints should never be an inhibiting factor when trusting Trigg as your
manufacturing partner.

#### Fast & Efficient Fulfillment

IN-HOUSE

Based out of Las Vegas, Trigg Labs is designed to fulfill orders directly from our 70,000 sq ft
facility. With loading bays and a team of in-house operations specialists, Trigg truly offers
end-to-end service.

#### Costing & Pipeline Planning

IN-HOUSE

A true partner to its customers, Trigg’s finance team will partner with your sourcing team to run
costing exercises and ensure you can continue to run a lean business without risking out-of-stocks.

#### Strategic Consultation

IN-HOUSE

With experience in both manufacturing and brand building, the executive team at Trigg Labs is ready
to scenario plan and provide perspective on the evolving personal care space.

#### From Small Batch to Mainstream Manufacturing

## With a history of betting on successful founders, Trigg Labs prides itself on partnering with
## promising brands to manufacture ideas into small batch runs, and scaling those brands lovingly
## over time.

## FAQs
* #### What can you manufacture?
  
  Specializing in personal care goods, Trigg Laboratories expertise ranges across:
  * Personal Lubricants
  * Cosmetics
  * Massage Oils
  * Delay Sprays
  
  Of particular note, Trigg Labs is one of the largest personal lubricant manufacturers in the
  United States.
* #### Are you ISO certified?
  
  Yes, Trigg Laboratories is an ISO 13485 and ISO 22716 certified manufacturer.
  
  ISO standards are used in manufacturing to help ensure that products meet customer expectations,
  are reliable, and are safe.
  
  ISO certification is a designation that verifies that a company's products, processes, or systems
  meet ISO standards. All Trigg Laboratories partners can rest easy knowing we are ISO certified.
* #### Are you FDA compliant?
  
  Yes, Trigg Laboratories manufacturers 510K FDA cleared formulas at scale.
* #### How do I get started?
  
  If you would like to discuss Trigg Labs manufacturing for you, please reach out to us [here][19]
  and one of our specialists will be in touch.

# About
# Trigg Labs

With over 30 years in personal care manufacturing, Trigg Laboratories continues to lead the U.S. in
domestic manufacturing for some of the world’s largest, and most loved health and wellness brands.
To understand how we can best service your manufacturing needs, simply click below.
* 30+ years of formulation expertise
* FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant facility
* Made in the USA
* ISO Certified

# Personal Care Manufacturing

# Personal Care Manufacturing

# The Meaning of T-R-I-G-G
* T = TRUSTED
  
  Over 30 years of experience, 240+ successful SKUs, and industry-leading compliance,
  FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant, and ISO-certified. Your product is in expert hands.
* R = READY
  
  With proven bestsellers and custom formulation capabilities, our white label and private label
  offerings are designed to get you to market faster, with zero compromise on quality.
* I = INSIGHTFUL
  
  We leverage our deep category knowledge to help brands anticipate trends, meet evolving customer
  needs, and navigate regulatory complexity, including FDA 510(k) innovation.
* G = GUIDED
  
  From your first consult to post-launch success, we offer hands-on support through product
  development, compliance, design, and go-to-market strategy.
* G = GROWTH-DRIVEN
  
  Whether you're launching DTC, FDM, selling on Amazon, or scaling into retail, our flexible MOQs
  and scalable systems are built for growth, yours.

[ Get Started ][18]
* ## Your brand. Our Expertise. Unmatched Together.
  
  Trigg Laboratories

# Our Services

#### Product Formulation

IN-HOUSE & VIA PARTNERSHIP

Trigg Laboratories is unique in that we offer both in-house formulation consultation as well as
working with third-party formulators to create and test samples until all parties have reached the
best quality product prior to manufacturing.

#### Volume Sourcing

IN-HOUSE

We source the highest-qualities ingredients and raw materials from around the world. All materials
are purchased in bulk quantities so you are able to benefit from economies achieved at volume scale.

#### At-Scale Manufacturing

IN-HOUSE

With 70,000+ sq ft, Trigg Laboratories has been engineered to scale manufacturing for all our
customers. Capacity constraints should never be an inhibiting factor when trusting Trigg as your
manufacturing partner.

#### Fast & Efficient Fulfillment

IN-HOUSE

Based out of Las Vegas, Trigg Labs is designed to fulfill orders directly from our 70,000 sq ft
facility. With loading bays and a team of in-house operations specialists, Trigg truly offers
end-to-end service.

#### Costing & Pipeline Planning

IN-HOUSE

A true partner to its customers, Trigg’s finance team will partner with your sourcing team to run
costing exercises and ensure you can continue to run a lean business without risking out-of-stocks.

#### Strategic Consultation

IN-HOUSE

With experience in both manufacturing and brand building, the executive team at Trigg Labs is ready
to scenario plan and provide perspective on the evolving personal care space.

#### From Small Batch to Mainstream Manufacturing

## With a history of betting on successful founders, Trigg Labs prides itself on partnering with
## promising brands to manufacture ideas into small batch runs, and scaling those brands lovingly
## over time.

## FAQs
* #### What can you manufacture?
  
  Specializing in personal care goods, Trigg Laboratories expertise ranges across:
  * Personal Lubricants
  * Cosmetics
  * Massage Oils
  * Delay Sprays
  
  Of particular note, Trigg Labs is one of the largest personal lubricant manufacturers in the
  United States.
* #### Are you ISO certified?
  
  Yes, Trigg Laboratories is an ISO 13485 and ISO 22716 certified manufacturer.
  
  ISO standards are used in manufacturing to help ensure that products meet customer expectations,
  are reliable, and are safe.
  
  ISO certification is a designation that verifies that a company's products, processes, or systems
  meet ISO standards. All Trigg Laboratories partners can rest easy knowing we are ISO certified.
* #### Are you FDA compliant?
  
  Yes, Trigg Laboratories manufacturers 510K FDA cleared formulas at scale.
* #### How do I get started?
  
  If you would like to discuss Trigg Labs manufacturing for you, please reach out to us [here][19]
  and one of our specialists will be in touch.

# About
# Trigg Labs

With over 30 years in personal care manufacturing, Trigg Laboratories continues to lead the U.S. in
domestic manufacturing for some of the world’s largest, and most loved health and wellness brands.
To understand how we can best service your manufacturing needs, simply click below.
* 30+ years of formulation expertise
* FDA-registered, cGMP-compliant facility
* Made in the USA
* ISO Certified

### Clearly the Finest Sensual Products

### What We Do

## Since 1993, the team at Westridge Laboratories, Inc. has dedicated themselves to the production
## of premium, high quality, and long-lasting personal lubricants. As the manufacturer of ID
## Lubricants as well as Private Label lubricants, we produce a variety of FDA 510k registered
## products. Our facilities are ready and able to meet the demands of all our clients, from
## up-and-coming vendors to multinational distributors. Located in sunny southern California, U.S.A,
## our state of the art FDA compliant manufacturing facility prepares and ships personal lubricants
## across the globe on a daily basis. Housing our production, shipping, and corporate offices all in
## one site has allowed us the flexibility to easily meet the needs of a wide range of customers in
## both US and global markets.

### 
### 
### 
### 

### Innovation

The success of Westridge Laboratories comes from years of innovation in a field that we are truly
passionate about. Lube is more than just a novelty to us, it is a product we strive to make better
than anyone else. While there are many options when it comes to personal lubricants, few companies
can say they have had their facilities certified to produce 510k medical devices by the FDA. Fewer
still can claim a successful track record spanning decades. Westridge Laboratories, Inc. goes above
and beyond to ensure that we produce nothing short of the best. Unique formulas, inspired design,
and years of commitment to excellence have helped make ID lubricants a brand that consumers trust.

### Research and Development

Here at Westridge Laboratories we are constantly researching, developing, and releasing new products
aimed to enhance pleasure and intimacy for people around the world. This has led us to many lines of
success, as we bring the consumer a product they can appreciate. While we do see success with what
we produce we will not stop in creating new products and improving on existing ones designs. Towards
that end, we will continue to work diligently to bring quality and pleasure for all of our consumers
to enjoy..

### FOLLOW US

# Performance Lubrication Products for Moderate to Extreme Conditions and Environments

## YOUR SUPERIOR PREVENTION AND PROTECTION SOLUTION.

**Whitmore is an established provider of innovative products and services which increase the
reliability, performance and lifespan of industrial assets. Whitmore offers an extensive range of
high-performance lubricants including: chain, open gear and rail lubricants - compressor, gear and
hydraulic oils - extreme pressure greases - friction modifiers - rail application equipment designed
to meet the specific needs of each industry and application. *Established in 1893.***

**Whitmore provides high-quality lubrication products through a global distribution network, proudly
serving industries around the world with a strong focus on the Industrial, Rail, and Mining
sectors:**
* **Industrial**: Our products are available worldwide, serving industries such as Steel, Cement,
  Power Generation, Food & Beverage, and Construction.
* **Mining**: Our products are available worldwide, excluding the United States.
* **Rail**: Our products are available worldwide, excluding Class I railroads in North America.

For over 130 years, relationships with customers, OEMs and our Distributor partners have helped
maintain our reputation for quality products, dependable service, and attention to customer
satisfaction. We continue to set the protection standard for lubrication and reliability products in
even the most adverse conditions and demanding environments.

*Whitmore is a brand and registered trademark of Whitmore Manufacturing, LLC., an ISO 9001-2015 and
ISO 14001:2015 Facility. *





[Testimonial from Jake Giles ]

We've been in business for 37 years, a Whitmore Distributor for over 30 of those 37 years. We
coupled with Whitmore to get the right lubrication product, in the right place, with the right
system applying it to save the customer money. By getting the right Whitmore products, we reduced
the lubrication amount that was needed by 40% and in turn saved the customer a significant amount of
money.

Jake Giles KM Specialty Pumps & Systems, Inc., Account Manager
[Watch the Testimonial][60] [We Want to Hear From You!][61]
[Testimonial from Bill Miller ]

We were looking for a dependable grease to put on our ball mills, we got with Whitmore and the
brought in a more reliable grease. By using Whitmore grease we cut our usage by 40% and our coverage
has really increased for our mills. We feel like we'll get longer lasting use out of our gears,
better wear protection and longer use of material.

Bill Miller Power Plant, Sr. Reliability Engineering Technician
